rules.title: Source changes
instructions: Read AGENTS.md and only the relevant entrypoints in docs/agent-context.json; preserve applicable nested instructions.
Follow the nearest existing implementation and public contract. Keep changes scoped and preserve compatibility, tenant boundaries and failure semantics.

rules.title: Validation and workflow changes
instructions: Use docs/agent-context.json for declared commands and limitations; inspect the actual script and target before running it.
Separate offline checks, mocks, live non-production execution and production observations. Record exact revision, command, result and blockers.
Classify application, test, authentication, dependency and artifact failures before changing source. Never weaken assertions to obtain a pass.
Update context metadata when paths or commands change, run python scripts/agent_context.py sync, then python scripts/agent_context.py check.
